title: Generator isomorphism for strict tensor towers
statement:
theorem podReindexingStrictTensorTowersGenerators
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D) :
    ∃ τ : ∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory,
        (podReindexTower l E g).obj
            ((integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E Y).obj (P.obj,Q.obj)) ≅
          (integralOperationsTensorTowerFunctor l E X).obj
            (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj,((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj),
      ∀ (P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
        (n : ℕ) (p q : ℤ) (U : X.ProEt)
        (x : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P.obj).X p).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
        (y : (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj Q.obj).X q).val.obj
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
        ((((τ P Q).hom.app (op n)).f (p + q)).val.app (op U))
            (integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E Y n P.obj Q.obj p q
              (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) x y) =
          integralOperationsTotalTensorSection l E X n
            (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj P).obj) (((podGoodReindex l E g D).obj Q).obj)
            p q (op U) ((((D.quotient P.obj P.property n).hom.f p).val.app (op U)) x)
              ((((D.quotient Q.obj Q.property n).hom.f q).val.app (op U)) y)

source.place: Steps 1 and 5, expanded in parent node proof: Completed tensor extension of a normalized completion comparison.

proof.text: Instantiate the existing tensor-chain comparison data at the finite stage some n using the finite closed structure and tensor model of the coefficient evaluation calculus. Its coefficient map equals the constant-section map defining isoReductionFiniteInverse. Commute completed scalar restriction with sectionwise reindexing using the completed projection square, then compose with the tensor of the two finite quotient isomorphisms supplied by D. The sectionwise, restriction and tensor-map generator formulas give the required finite-level formula.

Prove every adjacent transition square. Precompose with the inverse of the comparison at n+1, then apply restricted total-tensor generator extensionality on X. Given two finite sections, apply the inverse quotient maps to obtain sections on Y. The finite comparison formula identifies the inverse image of their tensor generator. The tensor transition formulas and D.QuotientTransition identify the two resulting images. Thus the square commutes on all generators, hence in every degree.

Package the finite homomorphisms and the proved adjacent squares with NatTrans.ofOpSequence. Use NatIso.ofComponents to assemble their inverses into a strict tower isomorphism. Its component formula is the already proved finite generator formula.

proof_origin.place: Steps 1 and 5; finite normalized tensor comparison, quotient-transition generator calculation, and strict tower assembly.
